text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,10,0],"thickness":150},"comment":"NiFeCo-Ta baseline, standard thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":650,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"standard crystallization step per SOP; substrate rating checked"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,10,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,0,10,0],"duration":24},"comment":"short durability check"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"ingest CP and durability results"}]}
